name: Search and Rescue
tagline: Design a multi-floor building, place responders and victims, and simulate an optimised rescue.
problem: Emergency response in complex buildings is hard to plan when every second counts.
solution: Users build floor plans in 2D and 3D, define scenarios and run simulations that assign responders and route them with optimisation and pathfinding under changing conditions.
demo_moment: Team-described: run a rescue scenario and watch responders' routes.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Goes beyond visualisation to optimised assignment.

lessons: Simulation lets judges see a plan, not just a map.
